entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well then, we will now begin today's[n]panel.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Our guest of honor is Goro Akechi.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I feel kind of bad, considering how[n]many people have gathered...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm sure you all would've been[n]happier to have a singer or a[n]mascot appear, wouldn't you say?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We'd appreciate it if you could tell[n]us about your experiences with the[n]notorious Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It'd be wonderful if you could[n]let us hear more about your[n]actual investigative process.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm not used to being the one[n]interrogated... so please go[n]easy on me.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: How much do you think he knows?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: He talks of how the Phantom Thieves[n]are dangerous, yet he says they[n]haven't committed any murders...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Either he has an idea who the true[n]culprit is, or he has uncovered the[n]identities of the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, Makoto... You gotta get it[n]outta him...!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: As much as you're allowed to say,[n]would you tell us how far along[n]your investigation is on them?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Getting right to the point, I see.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well, if it's as much as I'm allowed to[n]say, then everything on TV and the[n]internet is all of it.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We don't have any leads yet,[n]and the methods behind their[n]crimes are still unclear.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I see...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Even with this country's power,[n]arresting them is proving to be[n]difficult... Is that the case?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I wouldn't phrase it that way...[n]but well, something like that.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thank you for answering that[n]question.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: By the way, it seems you've denied[n]a correlation between the Phantom[n]Thieves and the murders...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Why the sudden change? Until now,[n]haven't you upheld your stance that[n]the Phantom Thieves are dangerous?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: How are you so positive that they[n]haven't committed murder?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Aren't you a little too comfortable[n]interrogating people? Why, it's as[n]if you're a prosecutor.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Ah, excuse me. This is something[n]I've personally been interested in,[n]so I couldn't help it...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But won't you tell us?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What reason is there that you'd[n]claim their innocence when you[n]previously stated they were unjust?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Mako-chan's really pressing[n]for an answer.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: She's pelting him with questions.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Every person whose heart they[n]changed have truly been criminals,[n]including Okumura...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Why, then, was he the only one[n]who needed to be killed...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Why is that?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I must admit... I couldn't deduce[n]a reason.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That's why I believe that case[n]should be thought of as if a[n]different party is responsible.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: And if— This is all hypothetical,[n]mind you.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: If the Phantom Thieves are the[n]ones I know of, I can't possibly[n]imagine they would kill anyone.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Your comment just now...[n]Does this mean the police have[n]already identified who they are?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Oh, no. The police haven't gotten[n]that far yet.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: But I have my own conclusions[n]about the true identities of[n]the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: He's gotta be bluffin'!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Pipe down!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: He's lying, right...?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But if it's the truth...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You're not going to ask me who[n]they are?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...It may have repercussions on[n]the investigation. Are you sure[n]you can share that with us?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It's only my personal opinion,[n]so announcing that here wouldn't[n]pose a problem.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: However...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...There is a possibility that[n]everyone present will hear the[n]truth before the police or media.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: The truth...?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: What's he planning on saying...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...That's quite the confidence[n]you have.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If you're so certain... then very well.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'd like to ask you then: who do[n]you think the Phantom Thieves[n]are, Akechi-san?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That idiot!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: No... there's no way he could have[n]any evidence...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: They're people you all know[n]quite well. The identity of[n]the Phantom Thieves are—

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Oh, it's mine. I apologize for the[n]interruption, but I can't turn off[n]my phone due to my job.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Would you mind if I step away[n]for about... ten minutes or so?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm terribly sorry, everyone, but[n]we'll be taking a break.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We'll resume the panel in ten minutes.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Please don't troll me online for this interruption,[n]okay?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Is there a room I may use?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There's the PE faculty office.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...I want you to come too.[n]There's a matter I want to discuss.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Your friends from yesterday are[n]here, aren't they? Can you bring[n]them too, if that's all right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Did you set this up...?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We only have ten minutes, you know.
